description: Cars, billiards, hedge trimming, a safe, vehicle bodywork, model building and windsurfing give Pat and Mat a sequence of hobby and repair jobs where the original activity rarely survives contact with their solutions unchanged.

s07e01.description: A puncture interrupts Pat and Mat's drive with bicycles on the car. Replacing the wheel becomes a problem of lifting, leverage and keeping the vehicle in roughly the correct orientation.

s07e02.description: Pat and Mat assemble a billiard table only to discover that it cannot be played properly. Their repairs turn the table itself into the main event before they ever get to demonstrate their cue skills.

s07e03.description: Pat and Mat decide the garden hedge needs a more decorative shape, but trimming living geometry proves harder than expected and each correction demands another correction.

s07e04.description: Pat wants somewhere secure for a valuable banknote, so Mat introduces a safe. The problem immediately shifts from protecting the money to finding a sufficiently secret place for the very conspicuous safe.

s07e05.description: Attaching a trailer damages the car's mudguards, leaving Pat and Mat to restore four bent panels with the kind of bodywork methods no sensible repair manual would recommend.

s07e06.description: A small accident with matches and glue inspires Pat and Mat to build detailed models, until their growing collection of miniature constructions begins interfering with the original reason they needed the matches.

s07e07.description: Pat and Mat arrive ready to windsurf and find the pond drained. Rather than abandon the outing, they try to refill the entire pond and keep finding larger ways to move water.
